TOUHOUANCIENTS_KEYWORD_TOUHOUANCIENTSATO: Look at the top X cards of your draw pile. You may discard any of them.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_KEYWORD_TOUHOUANCIENTCHER: Restore the Max HP you lost due to [purple]Ink-Dyed Cherry Blossoms[/purple].
